panels.title: Services
panels.description: Every configured sing-box service must have a fresh successful API snapshot. Zero is a failure, not idle traffic.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Live routed connections and UDP sessions. DNS outbound excluded. Independent of protocol filter.

panels.title: Period traffic
panels.description: Exact API total counters, reset-aware Prometheus increase. Sampling/extrapolation at range edges; not network wire bytes.

panels.title: Service availability
panels.description: Fresh API availability; missing exporter scrapes are gaps, not zero.

panels.title: Payload bandwidth by host
panels.description: Exact service counters. Includes connections that begin and end between polls. Upload and download are both positive.

panels.title: Observed protocol bandwidth · sampled
panels.description: Lower-bound breakdown; API sampling interval is configurable per host. Short connections and traffic after their last sample are not attributed; use fleet totals for total traffic.

panels.title: Observed new connections · sampled
panels.description: New sessions observed after first snapshot. Not exact connection acceptance or failed authentication counts.

panels.title: Active routing paths
panels.description: Protocol/inbound/network/egress intersections, not just separate filters.

panels.title: Configured protocol listeners
panels.description: Inventory includes idle listeners. API collection health is shown above; inventory is not a synthetic connectivity probe.

panels.title: Source connections
panels.description: Active routed sessions and socket-weighted mean physical TCP RTT by host/service/protocol/bounded source IP. TCP RTT is pooled across listeners of the same protocol; UDP/QUIC and idle/unsupported RTT are blank, not zero. Pre-auth TCP sockets can have RTT without a routed-session count. All three global filters apply. NAT/relay IPs are not individual users; maximum RTT remains in the latency chart.

panels.title: Observed source bandwidth · sampled
panels.description: Top sampled client sources. No connection IDs, domains, destination IPs or ephemeral ports are stored in Prometheus.

panels.title: Source active-connection bytes
panels.description: Lifetime bytes of currently active connections; this is a gauge and can decrease when connections close.

panels.title: Source label budget
panels.description: Default: 32 distinct IP labels per host, persisted permanently until explicitly reset. Further clients aggregate under other.

panels.title: TCP RTT · socket-weighted mean
panels.description: Passive Linux smoothed ACK round-trip time of physical client-facing TCP sockets. Not one-way or website latency. Includes pre-authentication sockets; excludes UDP/QUIC and samples whose last ACK is older than 120s by default. Idle/unsupported is no data, not zero.

panels.title: TCP RTT · current p95 / maximum
panels.description: p95 is a bucket-based estimate across CURRENT physical TCP sockets, not the 95th percentile of all packets or past connections. Maximum is exact for the observed SRTTs. No rate() is used on these snapshot gauges.

panels.title: TCP RTT sample coverage
panels.description: Counts physical TCP sockets, not Clash routed sessions. A lower recent-RTT count means missing initialization or last ACK older than the configured idle limit. It does not indicate packet loss.

panels.title: TCP sample last-ACK age
panels.description: Oldest last-ACK age among included RTT samples. Passive sampling reads existing kernel estimates; it cannot refresh an idle connection without new traffic.

panels.title: TCP collector availability
panels.description: Fresh successful socket diagnostic snapshots. Independent of the Clash API; failures omit stale RTT. Collection runs without root, packet capture, pings or eBPF.

panels.title: sing-box CPU
panels.description: Percent of one CPU core. Process counter refresh interval is configurable per host.

panels.title: Prometheus scrape samples
panels.description: Monitor series cost. Scrape intervals are configured per target; keep a bounded sample limit in Prometheus.
